en: Fixed ctrl+enter (send now) only queuing a message when pressed before the response had started, and restarting a prompt's hooks while leaving the message queued when pressed while those hooks were running
zh: 修复了 ctrl+enter（立即发送）的问题：在响应开始前按下时只会将消息排队；在 prompt 的 hook 运行期间按下时会重启该 prompt 的 hook，却仍将消息留在队列中
